review_checklist: Physically align leader and follower within the existing 12 degree paired-pose body limit while torque remains off.
Confirm workspace clear and owner bounded-motion authority are still true.
Confirm both device paths and calibration hashes match this packet.
Fill reviewer, reviewed_at, and decision_id, then flip only this packet's admission boolean.
Run exactly once; the runner rereads the follower pose and uses it as the only target.

commands_after_review.audit: uv run sim2claw physical-recording-replay-eligibility --recording <recording-dir> --manifest-output outputs/p6/exact_replay_manifest.json --report-output outputs/p6/exact_replay_report.json
commands_after_review.replay: uv run sim2claw replay-eligible-physical-recording --recording <recording-dir> --manifest outputs/p6/exact_replay_manifest.json --output outputs/p6/replay

expected_hash_equality: record receipt gateway-sent radians SHA256 = P4 applied-action SHA256 = P5 consumed-action SHA256
